title: Strawberries Romanoff
hookLine: Russian-inspired strawberries romanoff with 5 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Chill Until Firmly Set
steps.instructionTemplate: In a medium bowl, combine hulled and quartered strawberries, 4 Tbsp sugar and 4 Tbsp liqueur, stir to combine then cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour and up to 2 hours, stirring once or twice. Incorporate {m53082_1}, {m53082_2}, {m53082_3}, and {m53082_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure strawberries first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Fold In Flavorings & Mix-Ins
steps.instructionTemplate: Two photos of cut strawberries in a bowl with one having sugar being added to the bowl Two photos of cut up strawberries for Strawberry Romanoff. Incorporate {m53082_5} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: Just before serving, in a large mixing bowl, combine 1 cup cold heavy cream and 1/4 cup powdered sugar, and beat with an electric mixer until stiff peaks form. Using a spatula, fold in 1/4 cup sour cream just until well blended.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: To serve, stir strawberries then divide between 6 serving glasses or bowls. You can spoon a little syrup over the berries if you like. You can also use this syrup to soak a cake. Spoon cream over strawberries, dividing evenly. You can also use an ice cream scoop with trigger release for a nice rounded puff of cream. Serve right away or chill and enjoy within 2 hours of assembly.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Measure aromatics and syrups before heating so timing stays crisp and your glaze hits glossy perfection.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 8 mins!
